_readme: The FAQ page (/faq/ and /es/faq/), page-level words only; the questions and answers themselves are in src/_data/faq.json. en and es must have the same keys. Plain text. Keep meta.description to about 160 characters (search results cut longer ones off); it names the main topics, not the questions address or Zoom numbers. hero.eyebrow is the small gold line above the page title, as on the other inner pages. groups: the headings the questions are sorted under, in the order shown on the page; each key matches the group of the questions in faq.json (add a key in both languages to add a heading). jump.expandAll/collapseAll label the button that opens or closes every answer (shown only when JavaScript runs). There is no contact line here: the footer band right under the questions prints the questions address.
